payload.title: Run Data Assimilation
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook executes a data assimilation process to reproduce the LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction as described by Tardif et al. 2019. It utilizes the _cfr_ codebase without modifications, running on high-performance computing resources. The notebook involves loading climate data, calibrating proxy system models (PSMs), and running a Kalman Filter-based data assimilation solver. The outputs include climate field reconstructions and ensemble time series for temperature and precipitation variables.
goals: Reproduce LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction using _cfr_ codebase.
Run data assimilation on high-performance computing resources.
Calibrate and apply proxy system models (PSMs).
Generate climate field reconstructions and ensemble time series.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook aims to reproduce the LMRv2.1 climate reconstruction using the _cfr_ codebase without modifications.
section_blurbs.heading: Run Data Assimilation

section_blurbs.blurb: Data required for reconstruction includes model output, instrumental climate data, and proxy data.
section_blurbs.heading: Load Data

section_blurbs.blurb: Proxy data is loaded and processed to fit the _cfr_ ProxyDatabase format, filtering by proxy type.
section_blurbs.heading: Load proxies

section_blurbs.blurb: The CMIP5 CCSM4 past 1000 simulation is used as the model prior for the reconstruction.
section_blurbs.heading: Load model prior

section_blurbs.blurb: Calibration data includes GISTEMPv4 for temperature and GPCCv6 for precipitation.
section_blurbs.heading: Load calibration data

section_blurbs.blurb: Proxy system models are calibrated to establish relationships between proxy data and climate variables.
section_blurbs.heading: Calibrate PSMs

section_blurbs.blurb: The forward model is run with the prior data to generate pseudoproxies for data assimilation.
section_blurbs.heading: Run PSMs

section_blurbs.blurb: Model prior fields are annualized and regridded to match the required spatial resolution.
section_blurbs.heading: Annualize and Regrid model prior fields

section_blurbs.blurb: The Kalman Filter-based DA solver is executed to adjust model estimates using proxy data.
section_blurbs.heading: Run DA solver

section_blurbs.blurb: Post-processing checks ensure the existence of climate field reconstructions and ensemble time series.
section_blurbs.heading: Figure checks

outputs: Ensemble time series for temperature and precipitation
